params.val: verified against Showdown data/abilities.ts: ADDED two missing mechanics shared by Desolate Land/Primordial Sea/Delta Stream (the 'strong weather' trio) -- (1) while active, no other weather-setting effect (move, item, or a non-strong-weather ability) can override it, only one of the other two strong weathers can; (2) if the holder switches out, the weather persists rather than clearing IF another Pokémon with the same ability is still active on the field -- it only actually clears when no holder of that ability remains active.
